candidates.title: LMCache: An Efficient KV Cache Layer for Enterprise-Scale LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Cross-engine KV-cache storage/communication layer spanning GPU, CPU, storage and network; fills a systems-infrastructure gap beyond per-engine cache optimization.
evidence: Supports KV offload/reuse and prefill-decode disaggregation across vLLM/SGLang engines
Reports up to 15x throughput improvement when combined with vLLM across evaluated workloads
